items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I tried to get him, but he was like a loner. All by himself all the time and I never knew when he was sober.

ctx.x: I remember that Tricky Sam always used to be down there at the end of the bar by himself. He was just having a little taste. Who else in that band are you --
I'm trying to think. I used to try to get next to -- what's the drummer's name.
